title: OS command execution via shell/sh(payload) (clojure) — review required
description: The clojure sink shell/sh(payload) launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via sh with an args vector.
remediation: Use sh with an args vector with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any shell/sh(payload) call matches.
